selected_frontier.reason: Current merged UnifiedDB->ClayGraph projection worker had strong ordinary crash/load evidence but a lease recovery invariant remained unmeasured. Broad duplicate clock-warp work was abandoned after swarm refresh found PR #399 and PR #400 covering backward/forward realtime discontinuities.

baseline.baseline_obligation: Any lease repair must rerun equivalent crash/takeover/shadow-load and remain non-regressive against these bounded measurements.

hypothesis: Lease expiry is a hard recovery fence: once a worker lease deadline has passed, the same fencing generation must not regain scheduling authority by renewal; continued operation requires fresh acquisition and a newer generation.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Generation fencing alone may be sufficient for safety: if no contender has yet acquired a newer generation, late renewal might affect only recovery timing and might not create simultaneous authoritative owners.

go_out_of_box.name: EXPIRED_OWNER_SELF_RESURRECTION
go_out_of_box.description: Acquire generation 1 with a 5000 ms lease, resume the same owner 1000 ms after its deadline, call renew directly, then attempt recovery by a second owner after the original deadline.
